description: This PHP source file defines the EndpointProxy class within the OrangeHRM HRM system, specifically in the API reporting namespace. The class extends the Endpoint class and provides methods to retrieve request, request parameters, validation decorator, and to set sorting and pagination parameters, mostly delegating to parent methods.

classes.name: EndpointProxy
classes.description: A proxy class extending Endpoint to handle report-related API requests and sorting/pagination configuration.

methods.name: getRequest
methods.description: Returns the Request object from the parent Endpoint class.

methods.name: getRequestParams
methods.description: Retrieves request parameters via parent class.

methods.name: getValidationDecorator
methods.description: Obtains the validation decorator object from the parent.

methods.name: setSortingAndPaginationParams
methods.description: Sets sorting and pagination parameters, delegating to parent method with provided filter parameters.

methods.name: getSortingAndPaginationParamsRules
methods.description: Provides rules for sorting and pagination, using parent implementation with specified allowed fields and exclusion rule.
